# Reverse-Scrolling Columns Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build a scroll stage with three infinitely-looping columns where the center scrolls down and the two flanking columns scroll up, with a live speed-multiplier slider that lets users break and restore the depth illusion.

**Architecture:** Single `index.html`. Cards are generated by JS (not hardcoded HTML) to stay under 300 lines. Each column-inner contains two identical card sets stacked; modulo math wraps the `translate3d` offset for seamless looping. The center column uses a `margin-top: -singleSetH` trick so its downward motion loops from above. A passive rAF-throttled scroll listener drives all three column transforms.

**Tech Stack:** Plain HTML5, CSS custom properties, vanilla JS. No libraries, no build step.

Create `animations/01-scroll-based/reverse-scrolling-columns/README.md`:

```markdown
# Reverse-Scrolling Columns

[Live demo](index.html)

## What it is

Reverse-scrolling columns place a normally-scrolling center column between
two flanking columns that scroll in the opposite direction. All three columns
loop infinitely using a two-set DOM structure and modulo offset math. The
opposing motion amplifies perceived depth: the brain interprets counter-motion
as evidence of different distances — the same cue used in parallax, but made
explicit and exaggerated.

## When to use it

- Hero layouts where bold visual contrast sets the editorial tone
- Portfolio or agency showcases that need motion without heavy assets
- Scrolljacking-free scroll-driven features (the stage drives its own scroll)
- Anywhere opposing motion is used intentionally to create visual tension

## How it works

Each column contains two identical card sets stacked vertically. A single
`scroll` event listener reads `stage.scrollTop` and feeds it into a
`requestAnimationFrame` callback that applies `translate3d` to each column:

```js
// Center column — scrolls down (margin-top pre-offsets by -singleSetH)
const cOff = scrollTop % singleSetH;
centerInner.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${cOff}px, 0)`;

// Side columns — scroll up at the multiplier's magnitude
const sideOff = (scrollTop * Math.abs(mult)) % singleSetH;
const sideY   = mult >= 0 ? sideOff : -sideOff;
sideInner.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${sideY}px, 0)`;
```

`singleSetH` is the height of one card set (12 cards + gaps), measured from
the DOM after card generation. The modulo keeps the offset in the range
`[0, singleSetH)`, producing a seamless wrap when the second set aligns
exactly with where the first set started.

## Key parameters

| Parameter | Default | Effect |
|-----------|---------|--------|
| `mult` | −1.0 | Side-column direction and speed; negative = reverse |
| `singleSetH` | measured | Height of one card set; determines loop period |
| Card count | 12 | More cards = longer loop period |
| Scene height | 2000px | Total scroll travel (max scroll ≈ 1380px) |

## Production notes

- **Infinite loop requires modulo math.** Without wrapping, columns run out
  of content after one traversal. The two-set structure (one visible, one
  waiting) ensures there is always content at either end.
- **Vestibular risk at high speed.** Opposing motion is a known vestibular
  trigger. In production, keep `|mult|` between 0.3 and 1.0; avoid values
  above 1.5. Always respect `prefers-reduced-motion` by setting `mult = 0`
  (side columns freeze) — opposing motion is specifically listed in WCAG 2.3
  as a hazard for motion-sensitive users.
- **Library equivalents.** GSAP ScrollTrigger can drive column transforms
  with `scrub: true` and custom callbacks per column. Locomotive Scroll
  exposes per-element `data-scroll-speed` attributes that accept negative
  values for reverse motion. Lenis + a scroll subscriber achieves the same.
- **Performance.** `translate3d` promotes each column to its own compositor
  layer. Pair with `will-change: transform` declared in CSS before the first
  paint. Never animate `top`, `margin-top`, or `height` — those trigger layout.

## See also

- [Parallax Scrolling](../parallax-scrolling/) — speed-ratio depth without
  opposing direction; the foundation this technique builds on.
- [Parallax Depth-of-Field](../parallax-depth-of-field/) — depth via blur
  rather than directional contrast.
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Reverse-Scrolling Columns</title>
  <style>
    :root{
      --bg:#060a10;--ui-bg:#0d1117;--ui-border:#21262d;
      --ui-accent:#58a6ff;--ui-text:#c9d1d9;--ui-muted:#8b949e;
      --card-bg:#161b22;
    }
    *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
    body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ui-text);font-family:monospace;
         padding:clamp(12px,3vw,24px)}
    header{margin-bottom:20px}
    header h1{font-size:clamp(11px,1.8vw,15px);letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase}
    header p{font-size:clamp(10px,1.2vw,12px);color:var(--ui-muted);margin-top:4px}

    .layout{display:flex;gap:clamp(12px,2vw,24px);align-items:flex-start}

    .stage{
      flex:1;min-width:0;height:620px;
      overflow-y:scroll;scrollbar-width:none;
      border:1px solid var(--ui-border);border-radius:8px;
    }
    .stage::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
    .scene{height:2000px}
    .columns{
      position:sticky;top:0;height:620px;
      display:flex;gap:8px;overflow:hidden;padding:8px;
    }
    .col{flex:1;overflow:hidden}
    .col-inner{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;will-change:transform}
    .card-set{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}

    .card{
      background:var(--card-bg);border:1px solid var(--ui-border);
      border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;
      display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .icon-box{
      width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:4px;flex-shrink:0;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    }
    .card-label{font-size:11px;color:var(--ui-text);letter-spacing:.3px}
    .card-meta{font-size:9px;color:var(--ui-muted);margin-top:2px}

    aside{
      width:clamp(200px,22vw,240px);flex-shrink:0;
      background:var(--ui-bg);border:1px solid var(--ui-border);
      border-radius:8px;padding:16px;
      display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;
    }
    .note{
      font-size:10px;color:var(--ui-muted);line-height:1.6;
      border-left:2px solid var(--ui-accent);padding-left:8px;
    }
    .lbl{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--ui-accent)}
    .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px}
    .row .v{color:var(--ui-text)}
    .tbl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
    .tbl .row{font-size:10px;color:var(--ui-muted)}
    .sr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10px}
    .sr input[type=range]{flex:1;accent-color:var(--ui-accent);min-height:44px}
    .sr .sv{width:40px;text-align:right;color:var(--ui-text)}
    .div{height:1px;background:var(--ui-border)}
    .tog{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px}
    .tog input{accent-color:var(--ui-accent);width:16px;height:16px;flex-shrink:0}
    button{
      background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--ui-border);
      color:var(--ui-text);font-family:monospace;font-size:10px;
      padding:17px 8px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;width:100%;
    }
    button:hover{border-color:var(--ui-accent);color:var(--ui-accent)}

    @media(max-width:600px){
      .layout{flex-direction:column}
      aside{width:100%}
      .stage{height:480px}
      .columns{height:480px}
      .col-right{display:none}
    }
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.col-inner{will-change:auto}}
  </style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <h1>Reverse-Scrolling Columns</h1>
  <p>A center column that scrolls normally while two flanking columns scroll in the opposite direction.</p>
</header>

<div class="layout">

  <div class="stage" id="stage">
    <div class="scene">
      <div class="columns">
        <div class="col">
          <div class="col-inner" id="inner-left"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="col">
          <div class="col-inner" id="inner-center"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="col col-right">
          <div class="col-inner" id="inner-right"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <aside>
    <p class="note">The illusion of the side columns 'flowing the other way' is purely visual — they scroll at the same speed as your input, just in the opposite direction. Setting the multiplier to +1.0× makes them move with you and the effect disappears.</p>

    <div>
      <div class="lbl">Scroll Progress</div>
      <div class="row"><span>Progress</span><span class="v" id="progress">0%</span></div>
    </div>

    <div>
      <div class="lbl">Column Offsets</div>
      <div class="tbl">
        <div class="row"><span>Left</span><span class="v" id="off-left">0px</span></div>
        <div class="row"><span>Center</span><span class="v" id="off-center">0px</span></div>
        <div class="row"><span>Right</span><span class="v" id="off-right">0px</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="div"></div>

    <div>
      <div class="lbl">Speed Multiplier</div>
      <div class="sr">
        <input type="range" id="mult-slider" min="-200" max="200" step="10" value="-100">
        <span class="sv" id="mult-val">−1.0×</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="div"></div>

    <label class="tog" for="match-tog">
      <input type="checkbox" id="match-tog">
      <span>Match direction (+1.0×)</span>
    </label>

    <button id="reset-btn">Reset</button>
  </aside>

</div>

</body>
</html>
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Insert the script block**

Find `</body>\n</html>` at the end of `index.html` and replace with:

```html
<script>
  const CARDS = [
    {s:'grid',    l:'Project Alpha',  m:'Design · 2024',   a:'#58a6ff'},
    {s:'circle',  l:'Studio Work',    m:'Motion · 2023',   a:'#bf91f3'},
    {s:'tri',     l:'Concept 03',     m:'Dev · 2024',      a:'#3fb950'},
    {s:'diamond', l:'Brand Atlas',    m:'Identity · 2023', a:'#f78166'},
    {s:'cross',   l:'Interface V2',   m:'UX · 2024',       a:'#ffa657'},
    {s:'arc',     l:'Motion Reel',    m:'Video · 2022',    a:'#79c0ff'},
    {s:'zz',      l:'Type Study',     m:'Type · 2023',     a:'#d2a8ff'},
    {s:'dot',     l:'Data Viz',       m:'Research · 2024', a:'#56d364'},
    {s:'lines',   l:'Scroll Kit',     m:'Library · 2023',  a:'#58a6ff'},
    {s:'hex',     l:'Space UI',       m:'Design · 2024',   a:'#bf91f3'},
    {s:'wave',    l:'Sound Tools',    m:'Audio · 2023',    a:'#3fb950'},
    {s:'ring',    l:'Orbit System',   m:'Motion · 2024',   a:'#f78166'},
  ];
  const SVG = {
    grid:   '<rect x="2" y="2" width="4" height="4" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="8" y="2" width="4" height="4" rx="1" fill="currentColor" opacity=".45"/><rect x="2" y="8" width="4" height="4" rx="1" fill="currentColor" opacity=".45"/><rect x="8" y="8" width="4" height="4" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/>',
    circle: '<circle cx="7" cy="7" r="4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/>',
    tri:    '<polygon points="7,2 12,11 2,11" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>',
    diamond:'<polygon points="7,1 13,7 7,13 1,7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>',
    cross:  '<line x1="7" y1="2" x2="7" y2="12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><line x1="2" y1="7" x2="12" y2="7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/>',
    arc:    '<path d="M3 10 Q7 2 11 10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>',
    zz:     '<polyline points="2,10 5,4 8,10 11,4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>',
    dot:    '<circle cx="7" cy="7" r="2.5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="3" cy="11" r="1.5" fill="currentColor" opacity=".5"/><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="1.5" fill="currentColor" opacity=".5"/>',
    lines:  '<line x1="2" y1="5" x2="12" y2="5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><line x1="2" y1="9" x2="9" y2="9" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/>',
    hex:    '<polygon points="7,1 12,4 12,10 7,13 2,10 2,4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>',
    wave:   '<path d="M2 7 C4 4 6 10 8 7 S12 4 12 7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>',
    ring:   '<circle cx="7" cy="7" r="5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="2" fill="currentColor" opacity=".35"/>',
  };

  function makeSet() {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'card-set';
    div.innerHTML = CARDS.map(c =>
      `<div class="card">` +
      `<div class="icon-box" style="background:${c.a}22;color:${c.a}">` +
      `<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14">${SVG[c.s]}</svg></div>` +
      `<div><div class="card-label">${c.l}</div>` +
      `<div class="card-meta">${c.m}</div></div></div>`
    ).join('');
    return div;
  }

  const leftInner   = document.getElementById('inner-left');
  const centerInner = document.getElementById('inner-center');
  const rightInner  = document.getElementById('inner-right');

  [leftInner, centerInner, rightInner].forEach(el => {
    el.appendChild(makeSet());
    el.appendChild(makeSet());
  });

  // Measure loop period AFTER DOM insertion
  const singleSetH = leftInner.children[0].offsetHeight + 8; // +8px = gap between the two sets

  // Center column: pre-offset upward so set A is above the viewport, set B is visible
  centerInner.style.marginTop = `-${singleSetH}px`;

  const stage    = document.getElementById('stage');
  const progEl   = document.getElementById('progress');
  const offLeft  = document.getElementById('off-left');
  const offCtr   = document.getElementById('off-center');
  const offRight = document.getElementById('off-right');
  const slider   = document.getElementById('mult-slider');
  const multVal  = document.getElementById('mult-val');
  const matchTog = document.getElementById('match-tog');
  const resetBtn = document.getElementById('reset-btn');
  const motionMQ = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  let mult       = -1.0;
  let ticking    = false;

  function fmt(n) { return (n >= 0 ? '+' : '') + n.toFixed(1) + '×'; }

  function update() {
    if (motionMQ.matches) return;
    const st  = stage.scrollTop;
    const max = stage.scrollHeight - stage.clientHeight;
    progEl.textContent = max > 0 ? Math.round(st / max * 100) + '%' : '0%';

    // Center: always scrolls downward; margin-top=-singleSetH makes it loop from above
    const cOff = st % singleSetH;
    centerInner.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${cOff}px,0)`;
    offCtr.textContent = Math.round(cOff) + 'px';

    // Sides: magnitude drives speed, sign drives direction
    const sideRaw = st * Math.abs(mult);
    const sideOff = sideRaw % singleSetH;
    const sideY   = mult >= 0 ? sideOff : -sideOff;
    leftInner.style.transform  = `translate3d(0,${sideY}px,0)`;
    rightInner.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${sideY}px,0)`;
    offLeft.textContent  = Math.round(sideY) + 'px';
    offRight.textContent = Math.round(sideY) + 'px';

    ticking = false;
  }

  stage.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (motionMQ.matches) return;
    if (!ticking) { requestAnimationFrame(update); ticking = true; }
  }, { passive: true });

  slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
    if (matchTog.checked) return;
    mult = slider.value / 100;
    multVal.textContent = fmt(mult);
    update();
  });

  matchTog.addEventListener('change', () => {
    mult = matchTog.checked ? 1.0 : slider.value / 100;
    multVal.textContent = fmt(mult);
    update();
  });

  resetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    matchTog.checked  = false;
    slider.value      = -100;
    mult              = -1.0;
    multVal.textContent = '−1.0×';
    stage.scrollTop   = 0;
    update();
  });

  update();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

## Self-Review

### Spec coverage

| Requirement | Covered by |
|-------------|-----------|
| 3 columns: left up, center down, right up | Task 3 — `sideY = -sideOff`, `cOff = +offset` |
| ~12 cards per column, portfolio tiles | Task 3 — `CARDS` array (12 entries), Style A |
| Cards: icon box, label, meta | Task 3 — `makeSet()` generates `.card` with `.icon-box`, `.card-label`, `.card-meta` |
| Infinite loop via modulo | Task 3 — `% singleSetH`; center margin-top trick; two card-sets per column |
| Single rAF-throttled scroll listener | Task 3 — `ticking` flag, passive listener |
| `translate3d` for GPU | Task 3 — all transforms use `translate3d(0,Xpx,0)` |
| Speed multiplier slider −2.0 to +2.0 | Task 2 (markup) + Task 3 (slider listener) |
| Slider at +1.0 = effect disappears | Task 3 — `sideY = mult >= 0 ? sideOff : -sideOff`; at mult=+1, sides move down with center |
| Match direction toggle | Task 3 — `matchTog` forces mult=1.0 |
| Per-column offset readout | Task 3 — `offLeft`, `offCtr`, `offRight` updated in `update()` |
